reason: The house is due after six years, but I will just call our painter like we always do. He has done our walls for years, he picks the paint, and I have never had to chase him, so I have no reason to bring in a company crew I don't know.
objection: These painting services send crews who disappear halfway. A signed date and ₹2,000 a day off is nice on paper, but I would still be the one living with a half-painted house and arguing over the bill, while my own painter simply turns up.
would_change_my_mind: If our painter could not take the job this season, or if a neighbour I know had their house done by them on the date they promised.
